title: feat(console): the app's menu is edited in the design mode (#36363)

_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbCxiFE11rsKwyNffJZKYqJs)_

repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jSr8sNCnJrK6Q9kEF5

Fixes #36363

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：管理员进入设计模式后，左侧菜单变成可编辑：每个分组底部有「添加菜单项」，点了先在那个位置占一行虚线框，再弹出选择面板（搜索框，按对象、视图、仪表盘、报表、页面、链接分类，只列已经存在、还不在菜单里的）；每一项鼠标移上去右边有「⋮」：上移、下移、移到分组、在前面或后面加一项、改名和图标、从菜单移除；也可以直接拖动。改动都等设计模式的「保存」一起写入并发布，所有成员都能看到；「取消」全部丢掉。安装来的应用（只读包）现在也能进入设计模式，改动存为本环境的定制。
- 为什么做：维护者要求菜单在运行界面里直接改，不再去 Studio；这是设计模式这条线的第二张卡。
- 出错会怎样：最坏情况是保存后菜单顺序或条目不是管理员想要的，再进设计模式改回即可；「移除」只是不在菜单显示，东西本身不删；若同一应用在 Studio 里有未发布的草稿，保存会拒绝并说明原因，不会覆盖别人的草稿。
- 要你做什么：无。一处与 ADR-0146 D5 不同的地方已由席位记入修订卡：安装来的应用，管理员页头的入口从「在 Studio 中查看」变成「编辑应用」（进入设计模式），这是本卡第 7 条的要求。

## What changes

While the design mode (#36362) is on, the sidebar draws the app's menu with its editor (`layout/DesignModeMenu.tsx`), instead of the plain menu.

- **Add menu item.** Each group, and the menu's top level, ends with 「Add menu item」. Pressing it holds a dashed row 「Choose a menu item…」 at that place and opens a picker: a search box over every kind, then the kinds Objects, Views, Dashboards, Reports, Pages and Link. A kind lists what exists and is not in the menu yet (`designModeMenu.ts` `targetKeyFor` / `entryForTarget`, one key per thing the menu opens); a record page is never offered. Picking one puts it in the held row.
- **The entry's 「⋮」 menu**: move up, move down, move to group (a submenu of the other groups and the top level), add an item before or after, rename and icon, remove from the menu. Removing takes the entry off the menu only; the picker offers it again.
- **Drag** moves an entry within its group or to another group (dnd-kit, pointer and keyboard).
- **Staged with the mode.** Every edit is staged under one key (`app-menu:<app>`); 「Save」 writes it, 「Cancel」 drops it.
- **The save** (`designModeMenuSave.ts`) writes the app with its new `navigation` where Studio's menu editing writes it (objectstack#30059, ADR-0146 D2/D3): the app's own package when the server lists it writable, else its paired customization package (asked of the ensure door, which creates it on first use), the body declaring the override at the base's listed version. It is written by the runtime's confirmed-save rule: a draft with the first-write pin (a draft already pending, from Studio say, is refused and said, never overwritten nor published), then publish; a refused publish discards the draft this save wrote. A landed publish refreshes the console's metadata, so the menu re-reads.
- **Installed apps enter the mode** (`ShellPageActions.tsx`): in the read-only (`view`) posture, 「Edit app」 now enters the mode where the customization door takes the caller; where it is walled off (a walled deployment, caller not the platform operator) the eye 「Open APP in Studio」 stays.
- **Outside the mode** the menu is as before: no 「Add menu item」, no editor 「⋮」.
- An app whose menu is split in areas keeps its menu unedited in the mode (the picker and the moves work on one menu tree).
- New i18n keys under `designMode.menu` in every hand-written locale, zh-Hant generated.

Read first, by risk:
1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/designModeMenuSave.ts`: where the write goes, and the pending-draft refusal.
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/ShellPageActions.tsx`: the read-only posture entering the mode, and the wall.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/designModeMenu.ts`: the pure edits (moves, drop placement, insert, ids).

## Tests

- New `layout/__tests__/designModeMenu-36363.test.ts`: move up/down stop at the group's ends; move to a group appends, never into itself; a drop lands before/after by direction; insert clamps; rename and icon patch; one key per thing; ids are unique.
- New `layout/__tests__/designModeMenuSave-36363.test.ts`: writable package saved and published; read-only package saved into its customization package declaring the override at the base's version; a base with no version refused before writing; an unlisted package refused; a pending draft not overwritten nor published; a refused publish discards the draft.
- New `layout/__tests__/DesignModeMenu-36363.test.tsx`: 「Add menu item」 per group and the top level, 「⋮」 per entry; 「Move up」 staged and saved; 「Move to group」; the held row and a picker offering only what exists and is not in the menu; search over every kind, no record page; remove and offer again; rename; 「Cancel」 after three edits leaves the menu and writes nothing.
- `ShellPageActions-36111.test.tsx`: a read-only package enters the mode; under the wall it keeps the eye; a writable package under the wall still enters.
- `UnifiedSidebar.favoritesMenu-12427.test.tsx`: outside the mode no 「Add menu item」 and no editor 「⋮」.

## Acceptance notes

- **ADR-0146 D5.** D5 draws the app → Studio bridge for a read-only package as a browse entry (the eye). For a caller the customization door takes, an installed app's 「Edit app」 now enters the design mode instead, as the card's item 7 asks (an installed app's menu is edited as this environment's customization). The seat records the D5 row on the ADR revision card #36086. A member, and a caller behind the wall, see what they saw before.
- **Where it is saved** is the same document Studio's menu editing saves, so a menu edited here shows in Studio, and the reverse.
- An app whose menu is split in areas is not edited in the mode (its menu is drawn unedited); no such app is in the showcase or HotCRM.
- Not in this PR, as the card says: new dashboard or report (#36364), adding, removing or renaming groups, visibility conditions, personal favorites.
- No docs page describes the runtime menu editing, so no docs change.

## Verification

Live run against a fresh local backend and the console (Vite), signed in as the seeded admin, on the showcase app (an installed, read-only package), at 1440 px:

- 「Edit app」 was shown (no eye) and entered the mode; the menu drew each entry with 「⋮」 and 9 「Add menu item」 rows.
- 「⋮」 on an entry opened the menu with 「Move to group」's submenu; 「Add menu item」 held the dashed row and opened the picker; 「Objects」 offered 11 objects not in the menu (Announcement, Client Brief, Expense Line, …); picking Announcement put it in the row.
- 「⋮ → Move up」 on Page Authoring moved it above Capability Map; 「Save」 was on, saved, and the bar went.
- After a reload the menu read Page Authoring, Capability Map, My Work, Approvals, New Project (Wizard), Settings, Announcement, Projects: both edits kept, written into the showcase's customization package.

Screenshots are in the project files at `repo-objectstack-7/shots/36363/`: `m-design.png` (the editor), `m-actions.png` (the entry menu), `m-picker-kinds.png` and `m-picker-objects.png` (the picker), `m-staged.png`, `m-after-reload.png`. The card's 「PR 正文附截图」 is met by those files: a cloud container cannot upload images to the PR.

Two minutes: as a workspace admin, open HotCRM, press 「Edit app」; under a group press 「Add menu item」, pick an object, press 「Save」; reload: the entry is there. Enter again, 「⋮ → Move up」 on an entry, 「Cancel」: the menu is as it was.
